openingSummary.zh:
小熊早上好！今天最大的产品消息：Gemini 4 Carbon 全面开放，Claude 把白板、表格和数据做成可协作产物。

Gemini 4 Carbon：@GoogleAI 与 @GoogleDeepMind 向开发者、企业、科学家与消费者开放，官方称面向网络安全与长周期 agent 工作流最强；独立工作流基准上称 CursorBench 4.0、Perplexity WANDR、Zapier AutomationBench 第一，任务成本不到下一名外部模型的一半。API 导入价与 Gemini 4 Argon 相同（每百万 token $2 输入 / $10 输出），介绍期至 11/30，之后 $4/$20；并在 Google Antigravity 预览 /swarm。与 Artificial Analysis 合作的新基准 MKA 上，官方称质量第 2、任务均成本不到第一名的 1/6。

Claude：开始推送 Whiteboards、Sheets（付费计划 beta）与 Data（原 Dashboards，现已 GA），并升级 interactive connectors，可在对话旁打开 Adobe / Atlassian / Box 等完整工具。

OpenAI / DeepMind：ChatGPT 商家能力公测（Business Hub / Business Agent）；周四将举办 Cyber at the Frontier 直播。工程侧同日还有 AlphaProof Code（用 agent 形式化验证 Signal 协议实现，生成逾 600 万行 Lean）以及 Gemini Robotics 2.5。

产品栏：Hermes Agent 新稳定版 v0.23.1、OpenClaw v2026.11.3、codex 稳定版前进到 rust-v0.167.1（说明几乎为空）。

缺口：@karpathy / @AndrewYNg / @Meta 近 48h 无高信号原创；关注列表仍无 DeepSeek 一手 X，近几日也无官方新模型；OpenAI 商家介绍页本机抓取 403，条目以官方跳转 URL 与 X 帖为准。
openingSummary.en:
Good morning! Biggest product news today: Gemini 4 Carbon is generally available, and Claude is shipping Whiteboards, Sheets, and Data as collaborative artifacts.

Gemini 4 Carbon: @GoogleAI and @GoogleDeepMind opened it to developers, enterprises, scientists, and consumers, calling it their strongest model for cybersecurity and long-horizon agent workflows. Official copy says it ranks #1 on CursorBench 4.0, Perplexity’s WANDR, and Zapier’s AutomationBench, at more than 2× lower cost per task than the next-best external model. API intro pricing matches Gemini 4 Argon ($2/$10 per million input/output tokens) through 30 Nov, then $4/$20; Google Antigravity is previewing /swarm. On the new MKA benchmark with Artificial Analysis, Google says Carbon ranks #2 in quality at more than 6× lower average cost per task than the top model.

Claude: rolling out Whiteboards and Sheets (beta on paid plans) plus Data (formerly Dashboards, now GA), and upgraded interactive connectors so a full Adobe, Atlassian, or Box app can open beside the chat.

OpenAI / DeepMind: Businesses in ChatGPT entered beta (Business Hub / Business Agent), with a Thursday Cyber at the Frontier keynote. On the engineering side, DeepMind also published AlphaProof Code (agents formally verified the Signal protocol implementation, generating over 6 million lines of Lean) and Gemini Robotics 2.5.

Product column: Hermes Agent shipped stable v0.23.1, OpenClaw v2026.11.3, and Codex’s stable line moved to rust-v0.167.1 (almost empty notes).

Gaps: @karpathy / @AndrewYNg / @Meta quiet on high-signal originals in ~48h; still no DeepSeek primary X on the watchlist, and no official DeepSeek model launch in recent days; the OpenAI businesses article returned 403 from this box, so that item uses the official redirect URL plus the X post.

summary.zh: 11/10（北京时间约 11/11 凌晨）由 Koray Kavukcuoglu 发布。Carbon 面向开发者、企业、科学家与消费者；官方称在 CursorBench 4.0、Perplexity WANDR、Zapier AutomationBench 获第一，任务成本不到下一名外部模型的一半。与 Artificial Analysis 合作的 MKA 基准上称质量第 2、任务均成本不到第一名的 1/6。API 介绍价与 Gemini 4 Argon 相同（$2/$10），介绍期至 2026-11-30，之后 $4/$20；Google AI Ultra 用户可在 Antigravity、Gemini 应用与 Search 的 AI Mode 使用。Antigravity 预览 /swarm。
summary.en: Published Nov 10 (about early Nov 11 Asia/Shanghai) by Koray Kavukcuoglu. Carbon is available to developers, enterprises, scientists, and consumers. Official copy ranks it #1 on CursorBench 4.0, Perplexity’s WANDR, and Zapier’s AutomationBench at more than 2× lower cost per task than the next-best external model. On the MKA benchmark with Artificial Analysis, Google says it ranks #2 in quality at more than 6× lower average cost per task than the top model. Intro API pricing matches Gemini 4 Argon at $2/$10 through 30 Nov 2026, then $4/$20; Google AI Ultra subscribers get it in Antigravity, the Gemini app, and AI Mode in Search. Antigravity is previewing /swarm.

summary.en: Timed with the X thread (~01:26 Nov 11 Asia/Shanghai). Whiteboards and Sheets are in beta on paid plans; Dashboards is generally available as Claude Data. Data can connect to tools such as Snowflake and Salesforce, with data stories, certified queries, and live sharing in beta. Interactive connectors can open a full Adobe, Atlassian, Box, or Notion app beside the chat or full screen. On Team all three are on by default; on Enterprise, Whiteboards and Sheets are off by default, and Data turns on by default on 19 Nov.

title.zh: AlphaProof Code：用 agent 形式化验证 Signal 协议的实现代码
title.en: Introducing AlphaProof Code: a breakthrough in verifying complex software at depth

summary.zh: 11/10 发布。DeepMind 称这是首次以该深度用 AI 形式化验证已广泛部署的密码协议实现，也是该协议实现首次被任何方法验证到这一层。框架由人类与模型共同写出规范，再由 Gemini Carbon agent 完成证明，生成逾 600 万行 Lean；人类只需复核约 1% 的代码。全过程约四周。把两处已修复的真实漏洞重新植入隔离版本后，系统均给出「不安全」的机器可检查证明。
summary.en: Published Nov 10. DeepMind says this is the first time AI has formally verified a widely deployed cryptographic-protocol implementation at this depth—and the first time this implementation has been verified that far by any method. Humans and models co-wrote the specs; Gemini Carbon agents produced the proofs (over 6 million lines of Lean), with experts reviewing about 1% of the codebase. The process took about four weeks. When two previously fixed real bugs were reintroduced in an isolated copy, the system produced machine-checked proofs that those versions were insecure.

alphaxivTop3.title: Embodied First Exam
alphaxivTop3.authors: Kangrui Wang, Qineng Wang, Changhe Chen, Pingyue Zhang, Chi Gui et al.

summary.zh: （Agent 优先；alphaXiv 热榜约第 1）面向「用编码 agent 控制机器人」的评测：允许 agent 自选直接控制、写代码控制等路径，补上现有基准偏视动策略学习、难以检验编码 agent 在物理约束下可靠性的缺口。
summary.en: (Agent pick; ~#1 on alphaXiv’s trending list) A unified, agent-native robotics exam: coding agents may choose their own control path (direct control, code-to-control, etc.), filling a gap left by benchmarks built around visuomotor policy learning.

alphaxivTop3.title: Sage-Taiyi: A Metacognitive Architecture for Scientific Discovery
alphaxivTop3.authors: Weida Wang, Benteng Chen, Yigeng Jiang, Shuchen Pu, Weiping Shen et al.

summary.zh: （alphaXiv 热榜约第 2）元认知式科学发现架构：显式监控证据、假设与未决问题，再据此调整下一步研究目标与可复用推理方法；在涵盖 10 个学科、50 篇论文、265 项任务的 Taiyi-Bench 上评估。
summary.en: (~#2 on alphaXiv’s trending list) A metacognition-inspired architecture that monitors evidence, assumptions, and open questions, then adapts what to investigate next and which reusable reasoning methods to use; evaluated on Taiyi-Bench (265 tasks from 50 papers across 10 disciplines).

alphaxivTop3.title: System Optimizations for Cost-Efficient Agent Harnesses
alphaxivTop3.authors: Jongseok Park, Jiaxiang Yu, Eric Zhou, Tony Hong, Sunga Kim et al.

summary.zh: （Agent / harness 优先；alphaXiv 热榜约第 5）指出任务准确率主要取决于所用 LLM，而 harness 侧（系统提示、工具等）对成本影响更大，同一模型与任务上最高可降本约 2.6 倍，并据此讨论 harness 侧的成本优化机会。
summary.en: (Agent/harness pick; ~#5 on alphaXiv’s trending list) Argues that task accuracy depends mostly on the LLM, while harness-side choices (system prompts, tools) move cost more—up to about 2.6× lower cost on the same model and task—and explores those harness-side optimizations.

summary.zh: 新稳定版 v0.23.1（GitHub published_at 2026-11-10T01:42:15Z，约北京时间 11/10 09:42，昨日早报之后）。补丁版：把自 v0.23.0 以来约 618 个已合并 PR 打成稳定标签。明确修复插件目录：11/9 站点发布的 `plugin-catalog.json` 超过客户端 2 MiB 上限，安装会静默回退到随包目录；本版把上限提到 16 MiB。完整精选说明要等到 v0.24.0。Desktop 安装包不随本标签更新。

summary.zh: 自 11/6 起 changelog 无更新条目。页面置顶仍为 2026-11-06 Voice Chat with Agents——与 agent 实时语音通话（Agents Window / IDE / Web / iOS），由 Grok Voice 驱动；可边聊边让 coding agent 干活并听进度。另有 11/5 Build Live Apps（Cloud Agent 脚手架 Web 应用、Postgres、Cursor SSO 并部署分享）。
summary.en: No newer changelog entry since Nov 6. Latest still 2026-11-06 Voice Chat with Agents—realtime voice calls with agents (Agents Window / IDE / Web / iOS) powered by Grok Voice; keep talking while the coding agent works and hear progress. Also Nov 5 Build Live Apps (Cloud Agent scaffolds web app, Postgres, Cursor SSO, deploy + share).

summary.zh: 官方 changelog 今日可访问，页面 Latest 现为 v0.79.3（2026-11-06）——共享 Pages 可切换并记住深浅色主题；同一 Slack 工作区的成员可直接私信 Team Bot 并新开对话；页面抓取失败时改由 Bot 直接读取；以及通话卡片、1Password 断开、Always allow 等修复。前一笔 v0.79.2（11/5）含新应用图标与礼物采购询问流程。Homebrew cask grok-bot 显示 Mac 客户端已到 0.79.4（高于页面 Latest）；官方未公布 0.79.4 功能说明。changelog 常滞后客户端，故对照写出两端版本。
summary.en: Official changelog reachable today; page Latest is now v0.79.3 (2026-11-06)—shared Pages can switch and remember light/dark theme; people in a shared Slack workspace can message a Team Bot and start a new conversation; if the usual page fetch fails the Bot reads the page directly; plus call-card, 1Password-disconnect, and Always-allow fixes. The prior entry, v0.79.2 (Nov 5), includes the new app icon and a gift-request flow. Homebrew cask grok-bot shows the Mac client at 0.79.4 (above page Latest); no official 0.79.4 notes. Changelog often lags—report both ends.
